bundle.shortDescription: Set up War Thunder test drives in a few clicks.
bundle.longDescription: Ask3lad Test Drive 3.0 lets you set up your own Ground, Naval, Air and Helicopter test drives in War Thunder. Pick a vehicle, choose its loadout, targets, map and weather, press Apply, then load the mission from User Missions in game.
